environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 behind a standard Application Load Balancer with no additional filtering. The ALB performs TLS termination and basic health checks only. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request inspection or filtering is configured at any layer.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules (forward to target group)
config.network: Public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
config.iam_role: ec2-card-service-role with SSM and CloudWatch permissions
